title: Re-signing moves the knot sphere's forced dissonance into the law and carries it anywhere
subject: What changing the signs of the knot's law can do with the dissonance that no change of state removes on a knot sphere
conclusion: On every simplicial knot sphere with Kasteleyn signs, every law with exactly two even faces is satisfiable wherever they sit, so one sign change at the violated line always moves the forced dissonance out of the states and into the law. With the state held fixed, sign changes made only at the violated line or at an even face carry the dissonance from any line to any line, and a closed walk of them equals a block change of state.
